requirement_status.requirement: Three roles and deterministic local policies
requirement_status.recommendation: Ship fixed policy versions with run manifest.
Carrier rescue is adjacent and immediate. Implement transport or describe the abstraction. Record hazard/assignment semantics explicitly.
20 Never replays agree exactly. Persist step reward and event traces for all methods.

requirement_status.requirement: Episode termination and matched task policies
requirement_status.recommendation: State the all-rescued early exit and its impact on exposure.
Role determines simulated behavior. Sender's own deliveries only approximate receiver memory.
64 equiprobable reconstructed worlds are used. Validate against known states and implement a temporal weighted update or revise the specification.
Approximate other agents' local histories and distinguish stale tracked positions from current observations.
Primary messages have unit cost. Document optional per-message cost metadata.
Use a frozen receiver-blind reference and verify invariance to actual receiver state, role and receiver roster at fixed local message features.
Use the same seeded routing rule in offline policy reproductions.
Preserve the main configuration and label offline H=15 estimator sweeps separately. Two main runs use oracle H=35.
Keep same terminal semantics in simulated states and observed episodes.

requirement_status.requirement: Paired clones, CRN, same policies, no subsequent communication
requirement_status.recommendation: Add branch-marginal and state-equivalence checks.
Separate validation from sender-memory mutation; test exact branch state changes.
Evaluate model error separately from finite Monte Carlo error.

requirement_status.requirement: Offline oracle, decentralized valuation and one active sender
requirement_status.recommendation: Automate end-to-end privilege checks.

requirement_status.requirement: Test rejects global-state reads along decentralized path
requirement_status.recommendation: Add a runner-level guard. Existing tests cover observation shape, local particle priors and oracle misuse.

requirement_status.requirement: Directed message cap, candidate kinds, pre-delivery decisions
requirement_status.recommendation: Enforce pre-delivery validation as a batch if adding multi-sender runs.
Reuse the online selection/tie rule in evaluation and handle empty agnostic shortlist.
Label Full as one heuristic-ranked message per eligible step, Random as randomized content/routing, and Fixed as every third step.
Equalize pair evaluations and enforce prespecified budgets prospectively.
Primary configurations have ten seeds. Persist seed/context data and test hypotheses on their stated estimands.

requirement_status.requirement: CMV, TarMAC, learned surrogate, multi-sender tests
requirement_status.recommendation: Treat secondary references and stretch work separately.
Use age variation and full-episode budget/cost arms.

H1.reason: 6/55, reconstructed 95% seed-cluster interval upper bound <0.30. Fast-hazard sensitivity inconclusive.

H2.reason: Matched-return descriptive comparison clears 20%; equal realized budget subset has CI [0,0] in default-matching run. Prospective budget match not executed.

H3.reason: Primary delayed-value analysis not executed or archived; exploratory delayed observations miss target, only four contexts across three seeds and distinct selector implementations.

H4.scope: Cost sensitivity for the tested aware H=5 policy and default-matching environment

Controlled staleness and failure review; capture late, stale and null contexts and report rescue alongside discounted return.
